project_type: .NET 10 solution (C#) — Trackdub CLI/TUI dubbing pipeline. Work is confined to the Trackdub.Cli TUI wizard and its xUnit test project.
build_system: dotnet CLI over Trackdub.slnx. SDK is provided via mise. mise.toml pins dotnet 10.0.302, but global.json pins sdk 10.0.300 with rollForward=latestFeature which selects the highest installed 10.0.x feature band. The custom Roslyn analyzer (src/Trackdub.Analyzers) references Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 5.9.0 (compiler 5.9.0.0), which is ONLY satisfied by SDK 10.0.4xx. Building with only 10.0.302 fails with CS9057 (analyzer references compiler 5.9.0.0 newer than running 5.6.0.0). SDK 10.0.401 has been installed in this environment and is selected by global.json's latestFeature roll-forward; the whole solution builds green with it.
test_framework: xUnit with Spectre.Console.Testing (TestConsole). Tests drive PipelineTuiScreen.HandleKeyAsync via ConsoleKeyInfo sequences and inspect wizard state.
build_command: PATH must include the mise dotnet-root. Run: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/dotnet-root:$PATH"; then dotnet build tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests --configuration Release -m:1 -warnaserror
verification_instructions: 1) Ensure dotnet on PATH via /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/dotnet-root. 2) dotnet build tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests --configuration Release -m:1 -warnaserror must succeed (0 warnings/errors). 3) dotnet test on the PipelineWizardStateTests filter must pass all tests. 4) dotnet format Trackdub.slnx --verify-no-changes must report no changes.
setup_instructions: SDK already installed. If missing: `mise trust /projects/sandbox/Trackdub && mise install dotnet@10.0.302 && mise install dotnet@10.0.401`. Then export PATH to include /opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/dotnet-root. Restore already completed successfully: `dotnet restore Trackdub.slnx -m:1` (network is OPEN_INTERNET; the previously-reported Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers transient failure no longer occurs).
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET — NuGet restore works. mise node@22.16.0 install fails (gpg/dev-tty) but node is NOT needed for these C# tests. Only build the Trackdub.Sdk.Tests project + its dependencies; a full-solution build is not required for these findings.
contribution_requirements: Build uses -warnaserror; keep zero warnings. dotnet format must pass (whitespace/using ordering conventions). Existing test file uses file-scoped namespace Trackdub.Sdk.Tests, collection expressions, and PascalCase test names in the pattern Method_State_Expectation.
key_patterns: PipelineTuiScreen (src/Trackdub.Cli/Tui/Screens/PipelineTuiScreen.cs) is internal sealed and implements ITuiScreen + ITuiOverlayScreen. It exposes public bool HasOverlay => _picker is not null (an OBSERVABLE signal that a picker overlay is active). Trackdub.Cli already has <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Trackdub.Sdk.Tests"/>, so internal members of PipelineTuiScreen and PipelineWizardState are visible to the test assembly. PipelineWizardState (same folder) is internal sealed with 12 configurable properties: VoiceClone(bool), TimbrePolish(bool, default true), RestorePan(bool), MatchLoudness(bool), AsrRefinement(bool), BurnIn(bool), ForceRerun(bool), ExportFormat(string?), SubtitleSource(string?), SubtitleFormats(IReadOnlyList<string>?), VideoEncoder(string?), TargetLanguageOverride(string?). ToRunOptions() maps to PipelineHandler.TuiPipelineRunOptions.
relevant_files: tests/Trackdub.Sdk.Tests/PipelineWizardStateTests.cs — the test file all four findings touch (5 tests today)
src/Trackdub.Cli/Tui/Screens/PipelineTuiScreen.cs — production screen with private _wizard field; add an internal accessor here
